candidates.description: This feature vector represents terms related to variance, difference, and divergence.
This vector activates on word roots and affixes related to physics, optics, and scientific measurements.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing or related to the root word "form" and its morphological variations.
This vector activates on adjectives that describe the frequency, manner, or quality of an occurrence or entity.
This feature activates on Latin roots, prefixes, and morphological fragments containing 'c' or 'u' sounds across various words.
This feature vector activates on space-related, astronomical, and atmospheric root words or prefixes.
This vector activates common prefixes and modifiers used to alter the scale, scope, or relationship of root words.
This feature vector represents adjectives in Romance languages, primarily Italian and Spanish, often indicating scale, quality, or status.
This vector represents common Italian grammatical articles, prepositions, and pronouns.
This feature vector activates strongly on the letter 'c' and various short letter combinations or prefixes starting with 'c'.
